Company snapshot: ArgusPeak builds a sales engagement suite used by mid-market tech firms. Evaluating LLM-powered SDR chat agents to automate first-touch outreach, email drafting, and calendar scheduling via tool calls. Priority: aggressive latency SLOs for agent UX (streaming response + tool calling).

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-18: Hosted API demo (Aisha/Marco) — ran live SDR scenario: 3-step cold outreach sequence + calendar find/insert. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-18_arguspeak_poc-demo.
- 2026-02-25: Security questionnaire sent; they asked for SOC2 + KMS integration notes. Jira SEC-9031 opened.
- 2026-03-01: POC kickoff: seeded with Hosted API credits. Baseline traffic: 50 concurrent agents, peak bursts to 200.
- 2026-03-05: Mid-POC sync. Latency numbers collected (hosted): median token latency ~45ms, P95 end-to-end turn latency ~380ms with tool calls; streaming enabled. Decision: need P99 < 300ms and better tool-call handshake to meet UX.
- 2026-03-07: Cost modeling call — they want Hosted for quick rollout but need a path to Dedicated to control unit economics at scale. Pricing deck link: /drive/pricing/arguspeak_pricing_playbook_v2.pdf.

Use-case / requirements summary:
- Workload: outbound Sales/SDR chat agents + helper for AE tasks. Heavy tool-calling: CRM write (create lead, update stage), calendar invites (two-way availability), email send/draft with templating.
- Latency SLOs: streaming token start < 100ms median, P95 end-to-end (including tool call roundtrip) < 250-300ms; P99 target < 350ms. Need graceful degradation if external CRM is slow.
- Throughput targets: steady 50 concurrent agents, planning for 150-200 concurrent in peak windows.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller fast open models for live agent (low latency) with option to route complex prompts to larger models. Interested in quantized variants and caching for repeated prompts.
- Routing/fallback: multi-tier routing: hosted -> dedicated -> fallback smaller quantized model; region awareness for NA customers.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for message-level events, KMS integration for key control, data residency requests for EU accounts.

POC details + success criteria:
- Phase 1 (Hosted API): validate streaming latency and tool-calling reliability under 50 concurrent agents. Measure token-level cost and end-to-end turn latency.
- Phase 2 (Scale test): synthetic load up to 200 concurrent agents; test autoscaling and queuing behavior.
- Phase 3 (Dedicated trial): pricing comparison and SLA discussion if Phase 2 above thresholds.
- KPIs: P95 turn latency < 300ms, tool-call success > 99%, per-agent monthly cost within modeled budget.
